identity.title: [v0.92][WP-20] Demo matrix, AEE proof, and proof coverage

values.review_scope: Review the WP-20 matrix, coverage table, activation ledger, AEE index, validator proof, and exact candidate paths for exact-revision traceability, ownership consistency, negative/platform coverage, and unsupported milestone claims.
review_prompts: Does every accepted row resolve to a current exact revision, command, artifact, owner, and review?
Are negative and platform limits explicit instead of inferred from positive proof?
Does the patch correct stale WP-20 ownership without taking WP-21/WP-21A scope?
Can any planned, synthetic, receipt-only, or historical artifact be mistaken for accepted feature proof?
